name: Shaanxi Zhongtian Rocket Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shaanxi Zhongtian Rocket Technology Co., Ltd., engages in the research, development, production, and sale of small solid rockets and related products in China and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Solid Rocket Business, Core Materials and Extended Business, and Measurement and Control Extended Business. It offers rain-inducing and hail-suppressing, guided, and sounding rockets; and systems engineering products, including manual and automated launchers, wireless transmitter controllers, mobile phone transmitters, weather modification communication terminals, digital weather modification systems, ground seeding systems, and aircraft seeding systems.
